apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: notification
  namespace: core-qa
  labels:
    app: media-streaming
    team: content-platform
    env: qa
  annotations:
    description: "Deployment for the notification service in QA environment"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: media-streaming
      team: content-platform
      env: qa
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: media-streaming
        team: content-platform
        env: qa
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: notification
          image: registry.example.com/media-streaming/notification:v1.0.2@sha256:c8a27b9f1b4c3d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0g1h2i3j4k5l6m7n8o9p0q1r2s3t4u5v6w7x8y9z0
          env:
            - name: GOMAXPROCS
              value: "4"
            - name: LOG_LEVEL
              value: "debug"
            - name: HTTP_TIMEOUT
              value: "60s"
            - name: GO_ENV
              value: "production"
            - name: METRICS_PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: "X-Api-Token" # placeholder for an actual header name, not a secret
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-secret
                  key: password
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:

    team: finance
    env: qa
spec:

      env: qa

      labels:

        env: qa
    spec:
      containers:

          image: quay.io/jvm-apps/fraud-detectionInventory-jvm:v1.2.3@sha256:e0b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5
          env:
            - name: JAVA_OPTS
              value: "-Xmx1g"
            - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
              value: "qa"
            - name: DB_POOL_SIZE
              value: "20"
            - name: JVM_HEAP_MAX
              value: "2g"
            - name: MANAGEMENT_SERVER_PORT
              value: "8081"
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: "X-Api-Token"
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-secrets
                  key: password
            - name: REDIS_HOST
              value: "redis.fraud-detection-inventory-qa.svc.cluster.local"
            - name: REDIS_PORT

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment

  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway-auth-qa
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: gateway-auth-qa
          image: nginx:sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855

            - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED

            - name: DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE
              value: "settings.qa"

              value: "4"
            - name: FLASK_ENV
              value: "development"
            - name: WORKERS_PER_CORE
              value: "2"
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: "X-Api-Token"
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: ledger-dev
  namespace: ledger-dev
  labels:
    app: ledger
    team: finance
    env: dev
annotations:
  description: DaemonSet for managing ledger application in development environment
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ledger
      team: finance
      env: dev
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ledger
        team: finance
        env: dev
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ledger-dev
        image: public.ecr.aws/lambda/java:11-v3.0
        env:
        - name: JAVA_OPTS
          value: "-Xmx512m"
        - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
          value: dev
        - name: DB_POOL_SIZE
          value: "10"
        - name: JVM_HEAP_MAX
          value: "512m"
        - name: MANAGEMENT_SERVER_PORT
          value: "8080"
        - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
          value: X-Api-Token
        - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
          value: "3600"
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: ledger-dev-secrets
              key: db-password
      volumes:
      - name: config-volume
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: data-volume
        hostPath:
          path: /data/ledger-dev
          type: DirectoryOrCreate
      tolerations:
      - key: "dedicated"
        operator: "Equal"
        value: "database"
        effect: "NoSchedule"
      affinity:
        nodeAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            nodeSelectorTerms:
            - matchExpressions:
              - key: kubernetes.io/e2e-az-name
                operator: In
                values:
                - e2e-az1
                - e2e-az2
      imagePullSecrets:
      - name: regcred

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: growth-telemetry-catalog-processor
  namespace: healthcare-dev
spec:
  schedule: "0 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: processor
            image: public-dockerhub-image@sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
            env:
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: "X-Api-Token"
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-secrets
                  key: password
            - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
              value: "1"
            - name: DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE
              value: "myproject.settings"
            - name: GUNICORN_WORKERS
              value: "4"
            - name: FLASK_ENV
              value: "development"
            - name: WORKERS_PER_CORE
              value: "2"
          restartPolicy: OnFailure

      env: dev

        app: auth-reporting
        team: e-commerce
        env: dev
